nc.description: A smooth white chain link connects two sections of faceted grey chain links.
A disorganized stream of grey blocks passes through a central geometric mechanism and emerges as an orderly arrangement of uniform grey rings.
A smooth, light gray, stylized model resembling a cannon rests on a flat surface against a white background.
A sliding block on a track pushes a lever mechanism that displaces a cluster of faceted shapes, with a wireframe polyhedron resting in the foreground.
Various white geometric and mechanical parts are arranged symmetrically around a central faceted sphere, with additional components organized into rectangular groupings in the corners.

vc.description: A robotic hand holds a cylindrical container and its detached threaded cap.
An exploded view of a mechanical assembly displays interlocking gears and shafts alongside a series of detached, ring-shaped components.
A close-up view displays a static, grey mechanical assembly featuring suction cups, a knurled central roller, and a hinged, serrated clamping mechanism against a white background.
A monochromatic mechanical assembly features a joystick-style handle connected to a geared cylindrical hub via articulated linkages and wire cables.
Various grey manufacturing materials, components, plastic pellets, and a finned enclosure are arranged neatly on a white surface.
